data.description: Permanent shelving location name (live:location)  REQUIRED  type: string pattern: UUID  -- OR a location's name instead of its UUID. Hard-coded to the tenant's real "Migration" location for every holdings record: ezborrow.tsv's own location values (Item_Permanent_Shelving_Location/Item_Holding_Location) don't correspond to any real location in this tenant, so mapping them directly produced holdings that failed to load (a fabricated ref:location id that doesn't exist server-side). Requires bin/build-inventory's --config to resolve the real id.
Temporary shelving location name (ref:location)  type: string pattern: UUID
Call number type name (ref:callNumberType)  type: string pattern: UUID  -- no source column in ezborrow.tsv; fill in a literal value here if needed
Call number prefix  type: string  -- no separate prefix column in ezborrow.tsv (only a single combined Item_Call_Number column)
Call number suffix  type: string  -- no separate suffix column in ezborrow.tsv

A universally unique identifier (UUID), this is a 128-bit number used to identify a record and is shown in hex with dashes, for example 6312d172-f0cf-40f6-b27d-9fa8feaf332f; the UUID version must be from 1-5; see https://dev.folio.org/guides/uuids/  type: string pattern: UUID  -- OR a statistical code's name instead of its UUID; either way it's applied to every holdings record. Add statisticalCodeIds[1], [2], etc. for more than one. A UUID is checked against the tenant's existing statistical codes; a name is looked up and replaced with its id. Anything not found is logged and dropped. Requires bin/build-inventory's --config to be set if any of these are filled in.

(A reference to) the source of a holdings record  REQUIRED  type: string pattern: UUID  -- OR a holdings source's name instead of its UUID. Hard-coded to the tenant's real "FOLIO" holdings source for every holdings record (this tool creates brand-new holdings, not migrated from MARC). Requires bin/build-inventory's --config to resolve the real id.
